body_coverage: Full Introduction, Related literature, Methodology, Results, Discussion and Conclusion; eight linked native tables. Figure-only frequencies and appendix prompts not independently inspected.
design: Spring2023 cross-sectional questionnaire:158 students (153 undergraduate,5 graduate) from one US university;68 teachers (mostly language teachers) recruited across institutions via contacts/snowballing. Six writing tasks, four divisions of appropriate use, examples generated with February2023 GPT3.5-turbo. Different populations, not matched institutional pairs.
parse_check: Native tables read. Table3 distinguishes existing competence, modelling, submitted output with disclosure, and without disclosure. Table5 means do not establish majority proportions. Printed outlining effect size r=-2.42 exceeds a correlation-like range; not adopted or silently corrected. Some teacher demographics sum67 rather than68, missingness unclear. Questionnaire wording rather than live behaviour is the evidential unit.

moves.problem: Broad support or opposition to AI hides distinctions that matter for writing instruction.
moves.author_move: Organizes acceptability around the task, the use of generated output, disclosure and whether student or teacher performs it; connects common reservations and role differences to a question about shared expectations.
moves.project_inference: First specify the action people judge, then compare genuinely comparable actions. A useful synthesis can reveal why apparent agreement at the tool level coexists with disagreement about its classroom role.
moves.condition: These are perceptions of the presented examples, not policy effectiveness, learning outcomes or universal ethical standards.

do_not_adopt: Do not infer learning harm from acceptance judgements or assert training would cause ethical behaviour.
Historical public claims about chatbot ownership, originality and model training are not verified legal or technical facts.
Teacher/student role is confounded with sampling context; causal explanations for group differences are not identified.
PCA grouping supports a description of responses, not a uniquely established moral framework.
correction_check: Current comprehensive correction/retraction status not verified; printed effect-size anomaly pending.
review_status: AI reading; conditional project suggestion; human review pending
